verses.commentary: Hear this word. The address is to the whole family brought from Egypt. Not northern kingdom alone but the entire people. What God did for all, all must hear.

You only have I chosen. Election language. Of all families of earth, Israel uniquely known. Therefore I will punish. The shocking therefore. Privilege increases accountability. More given, more required.
Do two walk together unless agreed? A series of cause and effect questions begins. Agreement precedes walking. There are no coincidences in divine action.
Does a lion roar without prey? Does it growl without catching anything? The lion roars over the kill. God's roar signals judgment already determined. The prey is caught.
Does a bird fall into a trap without bait? Does a trap spring without catching? The trap works because the bait was taken. Israel took the bait of idolatry and injustice.
When a trumpet sounds, do people not tremble? When disaster comes, has not the Lord caused it? The theology is clear: God governs history. Disaster is not random but purposeful.
The Sovereign Lord does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets. God warns before acting. Amos's message is itself evidence of coming judgment. Prophecy precedes punishment.

The lion has roared, who will not fear? The Lord has spoken, who can but prophesy? Amos explains his compulsion. He speaks because God has spoken. The prophet has no choice but to deliver the message.
Proclaim to Ashdod and Egypt: assemble on Samaria's mountains. Pagan witnesses summoned to observe Israel's crimes. If even pagans can see the injustice, how blind is Israel?
They do not know how to do right. Injustice has become so habitual they have forgotten righteousness. Their fortresses store plunder and loot. Wealth built on theft.
An enemy will overrun the land. Assyria unnamed but imminent. Strongholds pulled down, fortresses plundered. What they stored through robbery will be robbed.

As a shepherd rescues two leg bones or a piece of ear from a lion's mouth. Only scraps remain. So Israel will be rescued, only remnants. A piece of bed, a corner of couch. Luxuries survive as fragments; people survive barely.
Testify against the house of Jacob. Formal legal testimony. The Lord God Almighty brings charges. Heaven's court convenes.
On the day I punish, I will destroy Bethel's altars. The horns of the altar, where the guilty grabbed for sanctuary, cut off and fallen. No asylum from God's justice.
Winter house and summer house demolished. Ivory houses destroyed, mansions gone. Seasonal luxury, architectural pride, all rubble. What they built on injustice collapses.
